description: Feature-dev backtracks with SCOPE_DISCOVERED when the discovered change is required by the acceptance criteria.
failure_mode: Model records AC-blocking work as deferrable discovered work, shipping a change whose acceptance criteria cannot hold.
prompt: While implementing issue #415 (acceptance criterion: `nightgauge status --json` includes each worktree's branch), you find the branch is not exposed by internal/worktree, internal/state or internal/status — three unplanned files must change before the criterion can hold. What do you do? End your answer with a single ```json fenced block containing exactly this object, with one value chosen for each field: {"action": "record_discovered_work" | "emit_scope_discovered" | "implement_now" | "ignore", "record_discovered_work": true | false}
